title: PatchProof shared definitions
description: Reusable bounded types. Not a record schema on its own. Every string is length-bounded; free text excludes C0 control characters (including ESC) and DEL so that terminal escapes cannot be stored in reviewed records.

schemaVersion.description: Record schema version. Only 1.0 exists; any other value is unsupported and rejected.

identifier.description: Lower-case slug for packs, profiles, and fixture contracts.

sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of bytes or of a deterministic manifest, prefixed with the algorithm.

imageId.description: Local Docker image ID (content digest). Tags are never an identity; floating tags are not representable.

commitId.description: Full Git object ID: 40 hex digits for SHA-1 repositories, 64 for SHA-256 repositories. Abbreviations are rejected.

testId.description: Stable reviewed test identifier, e.g. AUTH-001.

pytestNodeId.description: Pytest node ID inside the pack's tests/ directory. Every path segment starts with a letter, digit, or underscore, so '.', '..', hidden files, absolute paths, and option-like values are unrepresentable. An optional class and a bounded parametrize suffix are allowed.

relativePath.description: Safe relative POSIX path. No leading slash, no empty segments, and no segment beginning with '.' (which excludes '.', '..', and hidden files).

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp in RFC 3339 form with a literal Z offset.

longText.description: Multi-line reviewed text. Tab, LF, and CR are the only permitted control characters.

runTermination.description: How the run ended. canceled = explicit operator cancellation (run lifecycle CANCELED); interrupted = worker or host stop without a normal finish (lifecycle INTERRUPTED).

reasonCode.description: Declaration order is the canonical output order (verdict specification section 8).

containerLimits.description: Per-container resource limits. All fields are required; a profile cannot omit a limit. Bounds are schema sanity limits, not approval: the reviewed values are bound by the profile hash.
